name: Gregory Wienberg
career_history: Senior Estimator at Burns & Mc Donnell, 11/2021 to present; Director of Preconstruction at NCB, 11/2018 to 10/2021; Director of Preconstruction at Luke Draily Construction Company, 6/2016 to 10/2018; Senior Estimator at Titan Built, 6/2016 to 10/2018; Senior Estimator at McCownGordon Construction, 5/2013 to 6/2016; Director of Preconstruction at Mctech, 1/2009 to 4/2013; Senior Estimator at Walton Construction, 5/2003 to 1/2009; Project Estimator at Titan Built, 5/2000 to 5/2003; General Foreman at Ironworkers Local #10, 9/1994 to 5/2000
education: Bachelor's degree, BUSINESS, MANAGEMENT, MARKETING, AND RELATED SUPPORT SERVICES, University of Central Missouri, 1990 to 1994
biography: Burns & McDonnell is a full-service Construction, Engineering, Architecture, Environmental and Consulting solutions firm with more than 13,500 construction managers, engineers, architects, planners, estimators, economists, technicians and scientist, representing virtually all design and construction disciplines. We plan, design, permit, construct and manage facilities all over the world, with the one mission in mind: make our clients successful. Being 100 percent employee-owned, we are each personally dedicated to making every client project a success. It drives our teams to provide tailored solutions that solve some of our customers’ greatest challenges. I lead Preconstruction & Estimating Project Team Estimates in the US, Mexico, Canada, UK and India. Our teams of construction and design professionals provide full turnkey services for critical infrastructure projects for both private and public clients in the Oil Gas & Chemical, Energy, Food and Consumer Products, Aerospace & Industrial, Manufacturing, Mission-Critical, Crypto-Mining, Commercial, Transmission and Distribution, Water & Wastewater, Aviation & Federal, Central Utility & Central Energy Plants, Transportation, Pharmaceuticals & Environmental Services.
